faqs.q: How long is an Australian visitor visa valid for?
faqs.a: Typically up to 3 years with multiple entries, allowing stays up to 3 or 6 months per visit.

faqs.q: Is a medical checkup required?

faqSchengenGeneral.q: How long does it take to process a Schengen Visa from Pakistan?
faqSchengenGeneral.a: Standard Schengen visa processing from Pakistan typically takes 15 to 30 calendar days after your appointment. However, during peak travel seasons (summer and winter holidays), it can take up to 45 days. We recommend applying at least 2 months before your intended travel date. AL ARBAB TRAVEL AND TOURS provides early appointment booking assistance to expedite the process.

faqSchengenGeneral.q: What bank statement balance is required for a UK or Schengen visa?
faqSchengenGeneral.a: There is no fixed official amount for Pakistani applicants. Embassies look for a steady balance over the last 6 months that comfortably covers your whole trip (flights, hotels and daily expenses) and leaves enough for your return. Send us your statement for a free check.

faqSchengenGeneral.q: Do you offer Umrah visas without full packages?
faqSchengenGeneral.a: Yes. We can prepare a standalone Umrah visa file for clients who book their own flights and hotels. A complete package can be simpler, because we arrange the hotels, flights and visa file together.

faqSchengenGeneral.q: Are you an IATA-certified travel agency in Islamabad?
faqSchengenGeneral.a: Yes, AL ARBAB TRAVEL AND TOURS is a fully accredited IATA travel agency. This means we issue air tickets directly from our Blue Area office on over 300+ global airlines, guaranteeing the cheapest live fares without middleman markups.

faqSchengenGeneral.q: Can I get a refund if my visa is rejected?
faqSchengenGeneral.a: Embassy visa fees and VFS/Gerry's service charges are strictly non-refundable as per government policies, regardless of the outcome. However, our consultancy fees are structured transparently, and we check every document before submission to avoid mistakes that lead to refusals.

faqSchengenGeneral.q: Do you book flights from Islamabad to London or USA?
faqSchengenGeneral.a: Yes. We book flights from Islamabad (ISB) to destinations like London (LHR), New York (JFK) and Toronto (YYZ) on Emirates, Qatar Airways, Turkish Airlines and British Airways, and we check student baggage allowances for you.

faqSchengenGeneral.q: What documents do I need for a Dubai (UAE) visit visa?
faqSchengenGeneral.a: For a standard 30-day or 60-day Dubai tourist visa, we usually start with a clear scanned copy of your passport (valid for 6 months), a passport-sized photograph with a white background, and your CNIC.

faqSchengenGeneral.q: Where is AL ARBAB TRAVEL AND TOURS located?
faqSchengenGeneral.a: Our head office is conveniently located at Eagle Plaza, Mezzanine No. 121, Fazal-e-Haq Road, Blue Area, Islamabad. We welcome walk-in consultations Monday through Saturday from 9:00 AM to 8:00 PM.

faqAir.q: How do I book flights from Islamabad to London?
faqAir.a: Contact our ticketing desk via WhatsApp or visit our Blue Area office. We compare fares across Emirates, Turkish Airlines, PIA, Qatar Airways and more and send you the fare and route options for ISB to LHR flights.

faqAir.q: Can I book group flights for Umrah or Hajj from Islamabad?
faqAir.a: Absolutely. We specialize in group bookings for religious travel, weddings, and corporate teams. We can block seats with minimal deposits and offer flexible name-change policies.

faqAir.q: Do you offer student discount flights from Pakistan?
faqAir.a: Yes. We partner with airlines like British Airways, Etihad, and Virgin Atlantic that offer special student fares with extra baggage allowance. Bring your university offer letter for eligibility.

faqAir.q: What airlines can I book through AL ARBAB TRAVEL AND TOURS?
faqAir.a: We issue tickets on all major carriers including PIA, Emirates, Qatar Airways, Turkish Airlines, Etihad, Saudi Airlines, British Airways, Air Canada, Lufthansa, Singapore Airlines, Thai Airways and other airlines.

faqAir.q: How fast can I get my e-ticket after booking?
faqAir.a: Once payment is confirmed, we issue your e-ticket and send it to your email and WhatsApp. We reply during office hours.

faqAir.q: Do you handle flight cancellations and date changes?
faqAir.a: Yes. Mon–Sat, 9am–8pm, we handle post-booking changes including cancellations, date changes, and name corrections as per airline policy.
